name: Hugette
source:
The plot revolves around a person who has lost his identity. His memory is made up of fragments of memories and countless illusions about himself and his past. Loneliness, fears and nightmares are crazy, but in one moment, everything changes.
A mysterious group of people who call themselves the Resistance appear in the life of the protagonist. Who are they, what are they fighting for, and why are they turning serious story into a comedy, a dating sim, and a post-homoerotic cooking shonen?
The tension is rising. Problems arise one after another, and despite the melancholy fun, drama cannot be avoided. Meanwhile, there are no fewer mysteries.
Can you keep your sense of reality?
